summary: Model inference never runs inside a transaction and all reconcile writes are single upsert/delete statements
context: W2.3 phase 2 implemented: git-HEAD probe on tool dispatch re-ingests records mid-session; schema v2 content_hash; async reconcile re-embeds only changed text. 968 tests + SOAK_SCALE=5 green.
rationale: concurrent reconcilers can duplicate work but never corrupt state, honoring the soak's BEGIN-IMMEDIATE rule without holding a write lock across ONNX calls.
